name: docs
description: Docs conventions for a project: a per-day changelog journal, one-file-per-item todos, and a feature registry with MADR ADRs, design docs and plan conversion, plus their CI checks.

interface.shortDescription: Changelog, todos and a feature registry under docs/
interface.longDescription: Keeps a project's docs/ honest: a per-day changelog entry for every commit, one committed file per deferred item, and a feature registry with MADR ADRs and design docs that approved plans are converted into before implementation. Ships the checks CI runs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the docs skills to record this change in docs/.
